Summer hay is lower and rougher than autumn, but 'being stacked' is subtle without comparison. Winter visibly half-used, exposing its pole.
Commission heading says approximately45, while listed families yield39. Reviewed complete explicit list, not an invented six-asset extension.

suggestions: At game integration keep skep and boundary-stone interaction labels or suitable close zoom; do not promise unassisted identity at 0.6.
Use cropped repeat texture at maintained vertical scale as in revised proof; avoid squeezing the full512px strip into short lines.
Place pollard willow by actual waterside terrain when integrated; proof is decorative offline placement only.
reasoning: Muted painterly materials agree with the attached game scene. Oaks have broad branches, willow has a visibly pollarded head, skeps are bell-shaped straw rather than modern boxes, cross is plain stone, hurdle pen is woven with no animals, and field patches remain flat without cloud volume. Assets contain no visible people, text or modern items. Twelve strip rows repeat three times without an obvious seam; measured paired edges also match. Sparse composition preserves clear grass and the original town. Final revised proof improves strip visibility and removes the earlier X intersection.
